title: Correlated sign phase sum
statement: Let $\rho,a,b\in\mathbb R$, and let $\sigma(\mathrm{false})=1$ and $\sigma(\mathrm{true})=-1$. Then the sum over $x,y\in\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ of $\frac{1+\rho\sigma(x)\sigma(y)}{4}\exp\!\bigl(i(a\sigma(x)+b\sigma(y))\bigr)$ equals the complex number whose real value before embedding in $\mathbb C$ is $\frac{1+\rho}{2}\cos(a+b)+\frac{1-\rho}{2}\cos(a-b)$.
